ai.title: Docs restructure: Intro/Advanced sections, FAQ expansion
ai.summary: Web docs sidebar splits into Intro, Advanced, and Project Showcase sections. Three files (how-does-it-work, large-projects, what-models) move from help/tips to new advanced/ category. FAQ gains usage and trust questions; getting-started drops --lite/--max flags for --create template command. keyboard-shortcuts renames to Special commands under tips.

eli5.text: The documentation sidebar on the website has been reorganized into three labeled sections, Intro, Advanced, and Project Showcase, making it easier to find articles for your skill level. Articles about how the assistant processes requests, works with large codebases, and uses AI models have moved from general help and tips into a dedicated Advanced section. The FAQ now includes questions about what tasks the assistant can perform and its data handling practices for users evaluating trust.

ai.title: --create auto-cds and runs codebuff
ai.summary: createTemplateProject now calls process.chdir(projectName) and execSync('codebuff') instead of printing manual cd/codebuff instructions. Eliminates manual steps after scaffolding. Affects npm-app/src/create-template-project.ts.

eli5.text: When you create a new project, the setup tool now automatically switches into the new project folder and starts a helper program for you, so you no longer need to type those commands yourself. You only need to run one command to get started, and the helper launches immediately. This affects anyone using the project creation command today.

ai.title: Add --version and -v flags to CLI
ai.summary: Added --version and -v flags to the CLI entrypoint in npm-app/src/index.ts. The flags read the version from package.json and print it to stdout before exiting. Help text updated to document the new flags.

eli5.text: If you run the assistant tool from a command line and add a special flag for version information, it will now simply print out which version you are using and then stop, instead of doing its usual work. This only affects people who start the tool by typing commands themselves; if you use it through a normal interface, you won't notice anything different. The version message is already live today.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.148
ai.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.147 to 1.0.148 in npm-app/package.json. Internal release increment. No functional changes.

eli5.text: Today's update to the assistant's version number (1.0.148) bundles a few visible changes that matter if you use the docs or create new projects. The help documentation has been reorganized into clearer Intro, Advanced, and Project Showcase sections, and the FAQ has grown. When you run the create command with auto-setup, it now automatically runs the code configuration step for you instead of requiring a separate follow-up action. The assistant's command-line tool now also responds to --version or -v to print its current version. These changes are live now for anyone updating to version 1.0.148.
